def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The matching edge segments are rulers; their endpoints determine the
    # columns of alternating stripes. Markers specify the stripe color.
    edge = grid[0][0]
    ink = next((grid[r][c] for r in range(1, h-1) for c in range(w)
                if grid[r][c] != edge and grid[r][c] != grid[0][-1]), 0)
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (edge, grid[0][-1])]
    # Here background is the dominant color; non-background top run is ruler.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] != bg and r not in (0, h-1)]
    # For each marker, form a line along its row, extending from its location
    # toward the nearer edge; preserve a 4 at the marker itself.
    for r, c in marks:
        color = grid[r][c]
        out[r][c] = 4
        for cc in range(c):
            out[r][cc] = color
        for cc in range(c+1, w):
            out[r][cc] = color
    return out
